title: LSP full rule set on save
summary: Runs the full lint rule set on save so the editor shows what the CLI shows
intro: Read this when the editor should publish the same findings as drag-lint lint, including dl:ok markers, instead of the small built-in set. It is the lsp --full-rules flag: opt-in on the bare server, ON by default in VS Code through the dragLint.fullRules setting (set it to false to switch it off). A separate mode from lsp --proxy, which ignores it. A slow machine never loses findings: the lint child is killed only when it makes no progress.

questions.ask: How do I make the editor show the same findings as drag-lint lint?
Why does an RTL file opened in the editor show no flow or type-aware findings such as used-before-assignment?
Will a slow machine make the editor lose the full-rules findings of a big file?
